title: There is No Theoretical Curse of Multilinguality For Embedding Space Structure
abstract: arXiv:2608.17088v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A central goal of multilingual NLP is to achieve high monolingual performance per language and cross-lingual alignment for large-scale language coverage with a multilingual model. The curse of multilinguality describes the phenomenon of degradation in multilingual model performance as we increase language coverage, posing a threat to the above goal. This paper asks whether multilingual embedding spaces are inherently incapable of achieving perfect multilinguality without a prohibitive increase in required capacity. We first formalize the goal of "perfect multilinguality", embodied in two multilinguality conditions. We then prove that the minimum dimensionality required for perfect multilinguality grows only logarithmically in the number of languages. That is, we show that there is no theoretical curse of multilinguality for embedding space structure. This suggests that the empirical curse of multilinguality is a result of real world data

translated_title: 多语言嵌入空间结构不存在理论上的多语言诅咒
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17088v1 公告类型：新 摘要：多语言自然语言处理的一个核心目标是，通过多语言模型实现每种语言的高单语性能和大规模语言覆盖的跨语言对齐。多语言诅咒描述了随着语言覆盖增加，多语言模型性能下降的现象，这对上述目标构成了威胁。本文探讨多语言嵌入空间是否本质上无法在不需过度增加所需容量的情况下实现完美多语言性。我们首先将“完美多语言性”的目标形式化，体现在两个多语言条件中。然后，我们证明实现完美多语言性所需的最小维度仅随语言数量对数增长。也就是说，我们表明嵌入空间结构不存在理论上的多语言诅咒。这表明经验上的多语言诅咒是现实世界数据的结果。
tldr: 本文通过理论证明，实现完美多语言性所需的最小维度仅随语言数量对数增长，从而否定了嵌入空间结构存在理论上的多语言诅咒，指出经验中的性能下降源于现实数据。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically proves that the minimum dimensionality for perfect multilinguality grows only logarithmically with the number of languages, refuting a theoretical curse of multilinguality in embedding space structure and attributing empirical degradation to real-world data.
